name: airlock
description: A browser tab where your agent analyses data it never sees.

scripts.verify:browser: vite build && node scripts/inject-token.mjs && node scripts/verify-browser.mjs
scripts.deploy: vite build && node scripts/verify-no-egress.mjs && node scripts/inject-token.mjs && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name airlock --commit-dirty=true
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.verify:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run verify:secrets && npm run verify:browser && npm run verify:live
